node_definition.done_when: pytest on the grouping test files passes with zero added failures against the base revision; For each run the landing record states the fraction of the archive the private store held, and gives the number of variables, the number grouped and the number ungrouped, the number of component groups and field patterns; the distribution of group size; the share of signals whose group has a single member; and the twenty largest patterns with their field counts, using invented names in tracked files. Negative control: a signal whose name does not parse is placed in an explicit ungrouped state and is counted, never attached to another component's group.

picker_selection.comment: Codex by the lead's standing choice; nothing in this node reads ICP or IDM content. The lead ruled that grouping starts now on the partial catalogue and is re-run when the archive scan completes: a separate rigel job (1317566) is still filling the private store at ~/.cache/imas-codex-codac-uda/full-census/catalogue.sqlite, so open that store read-only, never write to it, never interrupt that job, and record the fraction of the archive it held when you read it. Reuse map from the design review: parse_variable_name in imas_codex/discovery/signals/variable_names.py already yields plant-system, component and control-function tokens and FacilitySignal already stores them; group enrichment and SignalSource membership live in imas_codex/discovery/base/grouping.py; the private catalogue store is imas_codex/remote/archive_catalogue.py. Extend those; add no second grouping or propagation path. Store groups in the graph only for the 94633 pilot signals already there, under the ITER facility; write no new signals to the graph. Make the grouping a command that can be run again unchanged when the scan completes. No real archive variable name, host or pulse name in any tracked file; use invented names in tests, reports and the figure. Illustrate the group-size distribution with one figure saved through imas_codex.plotting's save function. Any pass over the store or the graph runs on a compute partition: env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID srun --partition=all_debug --time=00:59:00, or sbatch on rigel. Regenerate the worktree's gitignored generated models with 'uv run --no-sync build-models --force' if stale; never stage them. If a file you must change lies outside the grant, edit it, list it in changed_paths with a scope_note, and carry on.
